name: EDHOC cipher suite negotiation
description: Test vectors for EDHOC cipher suite negotiation (spec 8.9). Suite 0 (AES-CCM-16-64-128, SHA-256, X25519, Ed25519) is REQUIRED for LICHEN. Negotiation uses SUITES_I in EDHOC message 1 per RFC 9528 section 3.5.

basic_negotiation.name: both_support_suite0
basic_negotiation.description: Both peers support Suite 0, negotiation succeeds

basic_negotiation.name: initiator_prefers_suite0
basic_negotiation.description: Initiator offers Suite 0 first, responder supports multiple

basic_negotiation.name: responder_only_suite0
basic_negotiation.description: Responder only supports Suite 0, initiator offers multiple

lichen_required.name: lichen_suite0_required
lichen_required.description: LICHEN nodes MUST support Suite 0, regardless of other suites
lichen_required.note: Suite 0 is REQUIRED per spec; all LICHEN nodes MUST implement it

lichen_required.name: suite0_takes_precedence
lichen_required.description: Suite 0 selected when both support it, even if other suites preferred

failure_cases.name: no_common_suite
failure_cases.description: No common suite between initiator and responder

failure_cases.name: non_lichen_peer_no_suite0
failure_cases.description: Non-LICHEN peer without Suite 0 cannot interop with LICHEN

suites_i_encoding.name: single_suite_compact
suites_i_encoding.description: Single suite encoded as int, not array (CBOR optimization)

rfc9528_selection.name: initiator_preference_wins
rfc9528_selection.description: Per RFC 9528, initiator's first supported suite is selected
rfc9528_selection.note: RFC 9528: first common suite from initiator's list

rfc9528_selection.name: responder_triggers_retry
rfc9528_selection.description: If responder doesn't support initiator's first choice, responds with SUITES_R

edge_cases.name: all_iana_suites
edge_cases.description: All IANA-registered cipher suites have defined semantics
edge_cases.note: Suite definitions per RFC 9529 / IANA EDHOC registry
